license_required.quote: A person shall not sell, solicit, or negotiate insurance in this state for any line of insurance unless the person is licensed for that qualification in accordance with this chapter.

issuing_authority.quote: "License" means a document issued by the director authorizing a person to act as an insurance producer for the qualifications specified in the document.

name.quote: "License" means a document issued by the director authorizing a person to act as an insurance producer for the qualifications specified in the document.

type.quote: the commissioner shall subject the applicant to a written examination

age_minimum.quote: Is at least 18 years of age.

moral_character_required.quote: the director shall issue a license under section 1205 or 1206a to an applicant if the director determines the applicant possesses good moral character to act as an insurance producer.

school_approval_basis.quote: from an institution approved by the commissioner.

exams.name: Insurance Producer Written Examination
exams.notes: Resident applicants must complete a prelicensing program of study before sitting for the exam. Exam may be waived for certain designations or prior licensees.
exams.jurisdiction: state (administered by commissioner or contracted testing service)
exams.quote: A resident individual applying for an insurance producer license shall pass a written examination unless exempt pursuant to section 1206b.

interval_years.quote: An insurance producer's hours of study accrued under this section must be reviewed for license continuance every 2 years under a schedule established by the director.

required.quote: before the review date of each applicable 2-year period provided for under subsection (1), an insurance producer wishing to renew his or her license shall renew his or her license by attending or instructing not less than 24 hours of continuing education classes approved by the director

hours_per_period.quote: not less than 24 hours of continuing education classes approved by the director or 24 hours of home study or online training

period_years.quote: An insurance producer's hours of study accrued under this section must be reviewed for license continuance every 2 years

topical_requirements.quote: Of the 24 hours of continuing education required, not less than 3 hours must be in ethics in insurance classes or coursework.

available.quote: The commissioner shall waive any requirements for a nonresident license applicant with a valid license from his or her home state, except the requirements under section 1206a, if the applicant's home state awards nonresident licenses to residents of this state on the same basis.

requirements.value: Nonresident applicant must be currently licensed and in good standing in home state, submit proper request and fees, and home state must award nonresident licenses to Michigan residents on the same basis.
requirements.quote: a nonresident person shall receive a nonresident insurance producer license if he or she meets all of the following: (a) Is currently licensed as a resident and in good standing in his or her home state. (b) Has submitted the proper request for licensure and has paid the applicable fees required by section 240.

insurance_required.quote: require the maintenance of an amount of professional liability insurance, commonly known as errors and omissions insurance.

definition_quote.value: "Insurance producer" means a person required to be licensed under the laws of this state to sell, solicit, or negotiate insurance.
definition_quote.quote: "Insurance producer" means a person required to be licensed under the laws of this state to sell, solicit, or negotiate insurance.

methods_authorized.quote: "Sell" means to exchange a contract of insurance by any means, for money or its equivalent, on behalf of an insurance company. "Solicit" means attempting to sell insurance or asking or urging a person to apply for a particular kind of insurance from a particular company. "Negotiate" means the act of conferring directly with or offering advice directly to a purchaser or prospective purchaser of a particular contract of insurance concerning any of the substantive benefits, terms, or conditions of the contract

value: Variable life and variable annuity products
Any other line of insurance permitted under state laws or rules
lines_of_authority.quote: An individual insurance producer may receive a license for a qualification in 1 or more of the following lines of insurance: (a) Life ... (b) Accident and health or sickness ... (c) Property ... (d) Casualty ... (e) Variable life and variable annuity products ... (f) Personal lines ... (g) Credit ... (h) Any other line of insurance permitted under state laws or rules.

resident_license_available.quote: A person applying for a resident insurance producer license shall file with the director the uniform application required by the director

nonresident_license_available.quote: a nonresident person shall receive a nonresident insurance producer license if he or she meets all of the following:

preexamination_education_hours.quote: provide for a minimum number of hours of classroom instruction or its equivalent in home study or online courses as follows: (i) For a program of study for health insurance producers, 20 hours of instruction. (ii) For a program of study for life insurance producers, 20 hours of instruction.

exam_waiver_designations.quote: The commissioner may waive the applicable examination or program of study requirements of this section for a person who meets any of the following: ... (c) Has obtained the chartered property and casualty underwriter designation, the chartered life underwriter designation, certified insurance counselor designation, accredited advisor in insurance designation, the chartered financial consultant designation, the certified employee benefit specialist designation, the certified financial planner designation, the fellow life management institute designation, the life underwriting training council fellow designation, the registered health underwriter designation, the registered employee benefits consultant designation, the health insurance associate designation, or the associate in risk management designation.

business_entity_license_available.quote: A business entity acting as an insurance producer shall obtain an insurance producer license.

designated_licensee_required_for_busines.quote: The business entity has designated an individual licensed producer responsible for the business entity's compliance with this state's insurance laws, rules, and regulations.

temporary_license_available.quote: The commissioner may issue a temporary insurance producer license for a period not to exceed 180 days without requiring an examination if the commissioner considers that the temporary license is necessary for the servicing of an insurance business

temporary_license_max_days.quote: The commissioner may issue a temporary insurance producer license for a period not to exceed 180 days without requiring an examination

appointment_required_to_represent_insure.quote: An insurance producer shall not act as the agent of an insurer unless the insurance producer becomes an appointed agent of that insurer.

appointment_fee.value: Fee as provided under section 240(1)(c) for each insurance producer appointed or renewed by the insurer.
appointment_fee.quote: An insurer shall pay an appointment fee and a renewal appointment fee as provided under section 240(1)(c) for each insurance producer appointed or renewed by the insurer.

appointment_termination_reporting_days.quote: shall notify the commissioner using a format prescribed by the commissioner of the termination within 30 days following the effective date of the termination

fiduciary_duty_for_funds.quote: An agent is a fiduciary for all money received or held by the agent in the agent's capacity as an agent.

rebates_prohibited.quote: a person may not induce the purchase of insurance through a particular agent or from a particular insurer by means of a promise to sell goods, lend money, or provide services, or by a threat to refuse to sell goods, lend money, or provide services.

misconduct_reporting_to_department_days.quote: An insurance producer shall report to the commissioner any administrative action taken against the insurance producer in another jurisdiction or by another governmental agency in this state within 30 days after the final disposition of the matter.

conditional_loan_insurance_tying_prohibi.quote: A lender shall not do either of the following: (a) Require a borrower to purchase any policy or contract of insurance through a particular agency or agent or with a particular insurer or fix or vary the terms or conditions of a loan as an inducement to purchase insurance.

naic_producer_database_used_for_verifica.quote: The commissioner may verify the insurance producer's licensing status through the producer database maintained by the national association of insurance commissioners or its affiliates or subsidiaries.

home_state_change_application_window_day.quote: A person licensed as an insurance producer in another state who moves to this state shall apply within 90 days after establishing legal residence to become a resident licensee pursuant to section 1205.

lapsed_license_reinstatement_window_days.quote: An individual insurance producer who allows his or her license to lapse for a reason other than not meeting the requirements of section 1204c may reinstate the same license without the necessity of passing a written examination if he or she does so not later than 12 months after the date of the lapse.
